questions.text: What is the register map of audio_gain: the offset, width, reset value and access (RW, RO, WO) of every register the host reads or writes?
questions.default: [{name: SAMPLE, offset: 0, access: RW, reset: 0}, {name: GAIN, offset: 1, access: WO, reset: 0}, {name: SOUT, offset: 2, access: RO, reset: 0}]
questions.reason: The oracle specifies reset 0 for the shell-visible register map; the gain state itself resets to 2068 as required. The GAIN register is write-only, and its reads return 0.
questions.answer:
SAMPLE: offset 0x00, RW, reset 0: [15:0] audio sample, two's complement; [31:16] read 0
GAIN: offset 0x01, WO, reset 0: [15:0] a write sets the gain register (values above 8192 give 8192); the register cannot be read back; reads 0
SOUT: offset 0x02, RO, reset 0: [15:0] sample_out = sample after the gain, two's complement; [31:16] read 0
shell: shell/PROTOCOL.md (version 1.0)
unmapped: offsets not listed read 0; writes to them and to RO registers are ignored

questions.text: What is pwm_audio's port AUD_PWM: its direction, width and value in reset?
questions.reason: The pin is implemented as a low-or-high-impedance output and is never driven high.

questions.text: What is pwm_audio's port AUD_SD: its direction, width and value in reset?
questions.reason: A constant-high output implements the specified always-enabled amplifier behavior.

questions.text: What is pwm_audio's port LED: its direction, width and value in reset?
questions.reason: A constant-zero output implements the specified leave-LED-off requirement.

questions.text: What does the board pin CLK100MHZ connect to, and how is it driven (push-pull, open-drain, pulled up, input)?
questions.reason: The board clock is an input and directly drives clk_sys.

questions.text: What does the board pin CPU_RESETN connect to, and how is it driven (push-pull, open-drain, pulled up, input)?
questions.reason: The board reset pin is an input used to derive rst_sys.
questions.answer: CPU_RESETN is an input on pin C12. Its push-pull/open-drain/pull-up drive mode and connection to rst_sys are not specified.
questions.evidence: - {name: CPU_RESETN, dir: in, width: 1, async: true, pins: [C12], iostandard: LVCMOS33}

questions.text: What does the board pin AUD_PWM connect to, and how is it driven (push-pull, open-drain, pulled up, input)?
questions.reason: The pin must only be pulled low or released, so it is represented as an open-drain board output.

questions.text: What does the board pin AUD_SD connect to, and how is it driven (push-pull, open-drain, pulled up, input)?
questions.reason: The amplifier enable is specified to remain high, so it is a push-pull output.

questions.text: What does the board pin LED[15:0] connect to, and how is it driven (push-pull, open-drain, pulled up, input)?
questions.reason: The required 16-bit LED output is left off and is driven push-pull.
questions.answer: LED[15:0] connects to pins [H17, K15, J13, N14, R18, V17, U17, U16, V16, T15, U14, T16, V15, V14, V12, V11] and is an output. Its drive type and any pull-up are not specified.
